scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")

local Config = {
    EmergencyRadius = 10,
    DistanceToParry = 0.65,
    ClashDistance = 22,
    ClashSpeed = 0.01,
    NormalSpeed = 0.05,
    PingBased = true,
    PingBasedOffset = 1.8,
    BaseWindow = 0.45,
    SpeedWindowFactor = 0.002,
    AccelWindowFactor = 0.0001,
    MaxWindow = 0.7,
    MinWindow = 0.25
}

local IsParrying = false
local LastClick = 0
local LastBallHit = nil

local velocitySamples = {}
local lastSampleTime = 0

local function FindBlockButton()
    local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not playerGui then return nil end

    local hotbar = playerGui:FindFirstChild("Hotbar")
    if hotbar then
        local block = hotbar:FindFirstChild("Block")
        if block and block:IsA("GuiButton") then
            return block
        end
    end

    for _, child in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if child:IsA("GuiButton") then
            if child.Name == "Block" or child.Text == "Block" then
                return child
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function ClickBlock()
    local btn = FindBlockButton()
    if not btn then return false end

    local clicked = false

    if getconnections then
        local function fireEvent(event)
            local conns = getconnections(event)
            if conns and #conns > 0 then
                for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
                    c:Fire()
                end
                return true
            end
            return false
        end

        if fireEvent(btn.Activated) then clicked = true end
        if fireEvent(btn.MouseButton1Click) then clicked = true end
        if fireEvent(btn.MouseButton1Down) then clicked = true end
    end

    if not clicked then
        pcall(function()
            btn.MouseButton1Click:Fire()
            clicked = true
        end)
    end

    return clicked
end

local function GetBall()
    local ballsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Balls")
    if not ballsFolder then return nil end
    local children = ballsFolder:GetChildren()
    for i = 1, #children do
        local v = children[i]
        if v:GetAttribute("realBall") == true then
            return v
        end
    end
    for i = 1, #children do
        local v = children[i]
        if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Velocity.Magnitude > 15 then
            return v
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function IsTargeted()
    if not LocalPlayer.Character then return false end
    return LocalPlayer.Character:GetAttribute("Targeted") == true
        or LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Highlight") ~= nil
end

local function SendAction(isClashing, ball)
    if IsParrying then return false end
    local now = tick()
    local cd = isClashing and Config.ClashSpeed or Config.NormalSpeed

    if not isClashing and LastBallHit == ball and (now - LastClick) < 0.5 then return false end
    if (now - LastClick) < cd then return false end

    IsParrying = true
    LastClick = now
    LastBallHit = ball

    ClickBlock()

    task.delay(cd, function()
        IsParrying = false
    end)
    return true
end

local function UpdateVelocitySamples(speed)
    local now = tick()
    table.insert(velocitySamples, {time = now, speed = speed})
    if #velocitySamples > 15 then
        table.remove(velocitySamples, 1)
    end
    lastSampleTime = now
end

local function GetAverageSpeed()
    if #velocitySamples == 0 then return 0 end
    local sum = 0
    for _, sample in ipairs(velocitySamples) do
        sum = sum + sample.speed
    end
    return sum / #velocitySamples
end

local function GetAcceleration()
    if #velocitySamples < 3 then return 0 end
    local first = velocitySamples[1]
    local last = velocitySamples[#velocitySamples]
    local dt = last.time - first.time
    if dt <= 0 then return 0 end
    return (last.speed - first.speed) / dt
end

local function ComputeThreat(ball, root)
    if not ball or not root then return nil end
    local ballPos = ball.Position
    local playerPos = root.Position
    local distance = (playerPos - ballPos).Magnitude
    local velocity = ball.Velocity
    local speed = velocity.Magnitude
    if speed <= 0 then return nil end

    local directionToPlayer = (playerPos - ballPos).Unit
    local velocityDirection = velocity.Unit
    local dot = directionToPlayer:Dot(velocityDirection)

    return {
        ball = ball,
        distance = distance,
        speed = speed,
        dot = dot,
        timeToReach = distance / speed,
        velocity = velocity
    }
end

local function AutoParryLogic()
    if not LocalPlayer.Character then return end
    if not IsTargeted() then return end

    local ball = GetBall()
    if not ball then return end

    local root = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end

    local threat = ComputeThreat(ball, root)
    if not threat then return end

    UpdateVelocitySamples(threat.speed)

    local isClashing = threat.distance <= Config.ClashDistance

    if threat.distance <= Config.EmergencyRadius then
        SendAction(isClashing, ball)
        return
    end

    if threat.dot < 0.5 then return end

    local timeToReach = threat.timeToReach
    if Config.PingBased then
        local ping = 0
        local netStats = Stats:FindFirstChild("Network")
        if netStats then
            local serverStats = netStats:FindFirstChild("ServerStatsItem")
            if serverStats then
                local dataPing = serverStats:FindFirstChild("Data Ping")
                if dataPing and dataPing:IsA("NumberValue") then
                    ping = dataPing.Value / 1000
                end
            end
        end
        timeToReach = timeToReach - ping * Config.PingBasedOffset
        if timeToReach < 0 then timeToReach = 0 end
    end

    local avgSpeed = GetAverageSpeed()
    local accel = GetAcceleration()

    local window = Config.BaseWindow + avgSpeed * Config.SpeedWindowFactor + math.abs(accel) * Config.AccelWindowFactor
    window = math.clamp(window, Config.MinWindow, Config.MaxWindow)

    if timeToReach <= window then
        SendAction(isClashing, ball)
    end
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    pcall(function()
        AutoParryLogic()
    end)
end)

--[[
	StamperTool - LocalScript
	Coloque este script em StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

	O que mudou nessa versão:
	1) CORRIGIDO: antes, ao clicar no botão, o jogo recalculava a posição
	   usando o mouse EM CIMA DO BOTÃO, então o bloco aparecia "atrás" dele.
	   Agora o preview PARA de se mover quando o mouse/dedo está sobre
	   qualquer parte da interface, então ele fica travado no último lugar
	   válido no mundo — e é ali que o bloco é colocado.
	2) NOVO: uma barra de seleção de textura (terra, grama, pedra, areia,
	   neve, gelo, madeira, metal, vidro, lava, luz) — clique numa opção
	   pra escolher o tipo de bloco antes de colocar.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse()
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Se esse script já rodou antes (testou de novo sem parar o jogo, ou tem
-- uma cópia dele em outro lugar), remove a interface antiga primeiro.
-- Isso evita várias cópias transparentes empilhadas por cima uma da
-- outra — o que faria parecer que "tem algo na frente" bloqueando o
-- clique nos botões.
local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("StamperGui")
if oldGui then
	oldGui:Destroy()
end
local oldPreview = Workspace:FindFirstChild("StamperPreview")
if oldPreview then
	oldPreview:Destroy()
end

-- ================== CONFIGURAÇÕES ==================
local BLOCK_SIZE = Vector3.new(4, 4, 4)
local USE_GRID_SNAP = true
local GRID_SIZE = 4
local MAX_PLACE_DISTANCE = 100
-- =====================================================

	{ Name = "Terra",   Material = Enum.Material.Ground,      Color = Color3.fromRGB(115, 82, 54) },
	{ Name = "Grama",   Material = Enum.Material.Grass,       Color = Color3.fromRGB(74, 130, 51) },

	{ Name = "Madeira", Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,  Color = Color3.fromRGB(130, 90, 50) },
	{ Name = "Metal",   Material = Enum.Material.Metal,       Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190) },
	{ Name = "Vidro",   Material = Enum.Material.Glass,       Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 230, 255), Transparency = 0.5 },
	{
		Name = "Lava", Material = Enum.Material.CrackedLava, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 0),
		Light = { Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0), Range = 12, Brightness = 3 },
	},

		Light = { Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 200), Range = 16, Brightness = 5 },
	},
}

local selectedType = BLOCK_TYPES[1]

-- Pasta pra guardar os blocos colocados
local placedFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PlacedBlocks")
if not placedFolder then
	placedFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	placedFolder.Name = "PlacedBlocks"
	placedFolder.Parent = Workspace
end

-- ================== BLOCO FANTASMA (PREVIEW) ==================

previewPart.Name = "StamperPreview"
previewPart.Size = BLOCK_SIZE
previewPart.Anchored = true
previewPart.CanCollide = false
previewPart.CanQuery = false
previewPart.Transparency = 0.5
previewPart.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
previewPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
previewPart.Parent = Workspace

local isValidPlacement = true
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

local function snap(position)
	if not USE_GRID_SNAP then
		return position
	end
	return Vector3.new(
		math.floor(position.X / GRID_SIZE + 0.5) * GRID_SIZE,
		math.floor(position.Y / GRID_SIZE + 0.5) * GRID_SIZE,
		math.floor(position.Z / GRID_SIZE + 0.5) * GRID_SIZE
	)
end

local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { previewPart }

local isDeleteMode = false
local lastHitInstance = nil -- a peça (do mundo ou já colocada) que a mira está tocando agora

-- Sistema de "mira central": em vez de depender de onde o mouse/dedo está

		-- modo apagar: a mira "abraça" o bloco colocado que está na frente,

		local canDelete = lastHitInstance ~= nil and lastHitInstance:IsDescendantOf(placedFolder)
		if canDelete then
			previewPart.Size = lastHitInstance.Size + Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
			previewPart.CFrame = lastHitInstance.CFrame
			previewPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
		else
			previewPart.Size = BLOCK_SIZE

				or (origin + camera.CFrame.LookVector * MAX_PLACE_DISTANCE)
			previewPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(snap(hitPosition))
			previewPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120) -- nada pra apagar aqui
		end
		isValidPlacement = canDelete
		return
	end

	previewPart.Size = BLOCK_SIZE
	local hitPosition
	if result then
		-- assenta o bloco em cima da superfície atingida (funciona em
		-- chão, parede ou teto, seguindo a normal da superfície)
		hitPosition = result.Position + result.Normal * (BLOCK_SIZE.Y / 2)
		isValidPlacement = true

		-- só como indicação visual, e marca como inválido
		hitPosition = origin + camera.CFrame.LookVector * MAX_PLACE_DISTANCE
		isValidPlacement = false
	end

	previewPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(snap(hitPosition))
	previewPart.Color = isValidPlacement and selectedType.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)

    local info = TweenInfo.new(time or 0.2, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

    Connect(handle.InputBegan, function(input)

            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = gui.Position
        end
    end)

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        end
    end)

    Connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
